How to Pay Your Property Taxes
How to Pay Your Property Taxes
Payment Options
ePay: Online or Phone
Tax payments can now be made online or by phone by electronic check, debit card, or credit card.
The given Service fees apply to ePay payments:
Electronic Check is $2 per transaction
Visa Debit Cards are $4 per transaction
Other Debit Cards and Credit Cards are 2.4% of the payment amount, with a minimum service fee of $2
Cards Accepted:
Visa
Master Card
American Express
Discover Network
Please note: No part of the service fee goes to the County.
Phone Payment
To make a payment by phone, please call 877-690-3729. When prompted, enter jurisdiction code 2404. You will need to have your Parcel number to make a payment. The Parcel (Property ID) number is located on your tax statement in the upper left corner under the Brown County logo or payment stubs. Please enter the 7-14 digit number, excluding all non-numeric characters.
The Auditor-Treasurer's office CANNOT take tax payments over the phone. You must use the approved third-party payment processor by calling the number listed above.
Online Payment
Visit our eNoticesOnline Payment Center. You will need to have your Property ID Number to make a payment. The Property ID Number is located on your tax statement in the upper left corner under the Brown County logo or payment stubs.
To make an online payment, type your Property ID number, including the R, P, or M and periods, in the search box and click Submit. For example: R000.000.000.000 or M00.0000.00000 or P00.00000

By Drop Box
The Courthouse drop box is located in the Law Enforcement Center Parking Lot located at 15 North Washington Street, New Ulm, or you may utilize the drop box in the parking lot of the License Bureau at 1900 North Franklin Street, New Ulm. Do not use CASH when making your payment.
By Mail
Brown County Auditor-Treasurer
P.O. Box 115
New Ulm, MN 56073-0115
Checks can be made payable to: Brown County Auditor-Treasurer
Your payment must be postmarked on or before the due date to avoid penalty. If your tax payment is past due, please contact the Auditor-Treasurer Office at 507-233-6613 for the actual payment amount.
Direct Payment Plan
With this convenient, hassle-free program, your property tax payment is automatically deducted from your checking or savings account. We offer quarterly, semi-annual, or annual payment plans.
To enroll, send a completed Direct Pay Authorization Form to the Auditor-Treasurer Office at P.O. Box 115, New Ulm, MN 56073-0115.
Residential or Agricultural or Commercial Direct Pay Authorization Form (PDF)
Mobile Home Direct Pay Authorization Form (PDF)
If the due date falls on the weekend, your payment will be processed the next business day. Payment reminders will be sent by email 10 days before the debit. Authorization will remain in effect until you inform the Auditor-Treasurer Office that you wish to cancel. It is your responsibility to notify the Auditor-Treasurer's office at 507-233-6699 if you switch bank accounts or wish to add or delete parcels.
Escrowed
Your taxes may be included in your mortgage payment. If your statement indicates that you are escrowed, your tax amount has been forwarded to the escrow agent for collection. Please keep a copy of the tax statement for your reference. For more information, please contact your financial institution.
Want to Go Green with eNotices
Visit eNoticesOnline.com to register for paperless notices and statements. You can register all of your tax parcels to be accessed under a single login and continue to view past eNotices from year to year. Setting up your eNoticeOnline.com account is easy. Click this link for step-by-step instructions.
Email Alerts
Take advantage of this free service that will send you a reminder of tax due dates and other programs that may affect your property taxes. Sign up by Email . Be sure to put Email Alerts in the subject line.
